analyst_view.overall: Early view: Paris FC (3rd) host Le Mans a week before their Paris derby with PSG, with no European games to manage. Le Mans (15th) are hard to beat at home but weaker away, where they lost 2-0 at Troyes; both sides commit plenty of fouls.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. I stay with it: Paris FC's games average about 2.7 goals and Le Mans' about 3.1. Paris FC's main threat Lassine Sinayoko had fitness worries in early November, which is worth rechecking.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.0 corners. I lean lower: Paris FC win 3.6 corners a game (16th) and Le Mans 3.0 (17th), two of the lowest rates in the league. Seven or so looks right.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards. I lean higher: Le Mans are 3rd for fouls (14.8 a game) and were described as over-aggressive at the back, and Paris FC are 6th (13.9). This has the makings of a stop-start game.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.6 shots. Season averages (Paris FC 13.5, Le Mans 10.7) sum to about 24, so I stay close. Le Mans shoot far less on the road than at home.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. Paris FC average 4.9 on target and Le Mans 3.6, which fits the site's figure. No reason to move it yet.
